title: Record DEC-213, the gate state-file contract, as an ADR in test-skills docs
description: opum-doc ruled DEC-213 architecturally significant for this component (ODOC-496, relayed by the leader), so it gets an ADR under docs/adr/ in this repository, written by this repository session, naming DEC-213. Today the contract exists only in gate.py comments and .quest records: a HEAD state file that exists but will not parse is a named violation that never passes at blocking levels (advisory mode stays a named WARN, DEC-213 (a3)); a corrupt BASE copy reads as empty and its entries count as newly added (DEC-213 (a2)). Seen by the TS-34 Stage 1 reviewer (finding 1, recorded on the completed TS-34 record): 0 matches in docs/, so the review profile cannot ground the contract. To Do, off the plan: it is built when a plan approves it. Link it from the review profile sources once it exists.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An ADR under docs/adr/ records the DEC-213 state-file contract (head fails closed, base reads as empty, advisory mode stays a named WARN) and names DEC-213 and its sub-rulings.
lore check reports no new error, and the review profile in .lore/agents/ can retrieve it.
